id: title:a-lider:gate the incoming query when a patch adds an insight to a shared dashboard

review.posthog_relevance: Dashboard membership and shared insight access control
review.reason: The change implements a security and access control improvement by gating dashboard membership updates against the query supplied in the incoming request rather than the stored query. This prevents potential exposure of queries a user cannot execute when sharing an insight, addressing a specific PostHog operational concern regarding shared dashboard access and query permissions.
